title: breakout_2 phone: auto re-login with no human (no latch, background login check, silent-logout alarm)
note: Operator 2026-10-10: login cannot depend on manual input. PR #17365 (draft, hold, manager merges).

observation.how_to_check: curl -s 'https://ict-bot.duckdns.org/api/bot/prop/status?account_id=breakout_2' | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d['status_age_hours'],[e['kind'] for e in d.get('phone_events') or []][-10:],(d['phone_heartbeat'] or {}).get('state',{}).get('last'))"
observation.what: breakout_2 phone_events shows login_started -> logged-in (login_ok or a logged_in heartbeat) and a fresh account_status after the new APK (phone-executor-apk.yml artifact phone-executor-1b-apk) is installed
